name: tyne
description: Goal-enforcement layer for AI-assisted coding sessions

commands.title: Tyne: Remind Me to Re-run Review

tyne.githubClientId.description: The GitHub OAuth Client ID for device flow authentication.

tyne.deviceAuthDogfood.description: Internal dogfood only: use Tyne browser device-auth login instead of GitHub Device Flow. Opt-in; does not change the default login for all users.

tyne.deviceAuthMode.description: Device-auth transport for dogfood. Default 'live' hits deployed device-auth-start/poll. Use 'mock' only for offline UI testing.

tyne.deviceAuthMockScenario.description: Mock device-auth scenario for dogfood UI/telemetry testing.

tyne.supabaseUrl.description: Tyne Supabase project URL used for hosted Edge Functions (US / default).

tyne.supabaseUrlEu.description: Optional EU-region Supabase project URL when Data Processing Location is EU.

tyne.enterpriseValidateReviewUrl.description: Self-hosted or enterprise-managed Validate & Review endpoint (project URL or …/functions/v1/tyne-validate-review).

tyne.managedValidationModel.description: Optional AICredits model ID override sent to the Tyne managed validation backend. Leave empty to use Tyne's managed fallback policy.

tyne.jira.assignedToMe.description: When enabled, Jira pulls only issues assigned to the authenticated Atlassian user.

tyne.linear.assignedToMe.description: When enabled, Linear pulls only issues assigned to the authenticated Linear user.

tyne.asana.apiKey.markdownDescription: **Experimental — not a supported integration.** Asana cannot pull tasks into Tyne yet, so there is no connect flow and no task list. This token only enables direct status updates and comments on a task you already reference by ID. Supported PM integrations are GitHub, Jira, and Linear.

tyne.notion.apiKey.markdownDescription: **Experimental — not a supported integration.** Notion cannot pull tasks into Tyne yet, so there is no connect flow and no task list. This token only enables direct status writes to a database row you already reference by ID. Supported PM integrations are GitHub, Jira, and Linear.

tyne.notion.databaseId.markdownDescription: Notion database ID used by the experimental Notion status write. Has no effect unless `tyne.notion.apiKey` is set.

tyne.notion.statusProperty.markdownDescription: Notion status property name used by the experimental Notion status write. Has no effect unless `tyne.notion.apiKey` is set.

tyne.projectLeadMode.description: Enable Project Lead Mode: auto workspace prep, drift detection, AI commit synthesis, and auto ticket close.

tyne.defaultBranch.description: Default branch to pull from before starting a thread.

tyne.driftSensitivity.description: How aggressively Tyne flags off-scope file edits.

tyne.validateReviewLineThreshold.description: Net new lines added across the workspace before Tyne suggests running Validate & Review.

tyne.validationReminders.enabled.description: Show automatic Validate & Review reminders for large edits, syntax errors, and long coding sessions.

tyne.validationReminders.cooldownMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between Validate & Review reminder notifications.

tyne.validationReminders.sessionMinutes.description: Minutes of active coding before Tyne suggests a Validate & Review checkpoint.

tyne.actionEngine.autoApplyPolicy.description: Which Action Needed remediations may one-click apply. applyable_only = verified code patches only; never = always require Agent Fix / Open.

scripts.vsix: node scripts/guard-vsix-no-deps.mjs && npm run compile && npm run package && node scripts/record-changelog.mjs package && vsce package && node scripts/verify-vsix-runtime-deps.mjs && node scripts/record-changelog.mjs vsix
